request.subject: city
request.description: Style: crisp modern high-colour pixel art in the manner of polished indie tactics games, selective coloured outline (darker shade of each fill instead of pure black), rich palette with hue-shifted shading and small highlights, clean readable clusters, medium detail, hard pixels. Subject: one small fantasy town as a single strategy-game map piece: a compact cluster of four chunky cottages with bright red roofs huddled around one tall round stone keep tower with a big red banner flag on top, short stone ring wall in front, compact footprint, strong readable silhouette. Consistent strategy-game camera: three-quarter view looking slightly down, subject faces down-right (south-east), whole subject visible and centered on a transparent background, nothing cropped. Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance; no other red anywhere. Must not include: ground tile, grass, terrain, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, text, letters, numbers, UI, health bar, selection ring, frame, multiple units, crowd, cropped subject, blur, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, photorealism; pure black outline everywhere, blurry pixels, noise, dithering mush.
